The decisive NEW test is incrementality over core momentum: within ret20 (core-momentum proxy) quintile bands, the 5d-formation top-minus-bottom forward spread must survive (double-sort), otherwise the short-formation continuation is just the same momentum the core already trades. f5/h10 cell selection is inherited from exp-20260601-007 and carries its multiple-testing debt, so the per-day t-stat is reported but is NOT treated as independent confirmation; the ret20 double-sort is the load-bearing evidence.

Overnight vs intraday return decomposition on the broad 1446-ticker universe: the equity premium accrues mostly OVERNIGHT (prev_close -> open) while the intraday session (open -> close) is flat or negative (the overnight-return anomaly). Decomposing each ticker-days close-to-close return into overnight and intraday components and aggregating across the canonical 3 windows should show mean overnight return significantly positive (t>=2, majority windows) and materially larger than mean intraday return. This is a time-of-day structural mechanism orthogonal to the cross-sectional momentum that the prior ranking/reversal lines reduced to, and it has direct relevance to core entry/exit timing (the system enters at next-day open).

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Rejected on drawdown drift only. The accruals / cash-conversion quality source was positively predictive: aggregate EV +0.9921 and PnL $+21,322.65 with positive EV/PnL in all three windows and no regression, beating the accepted compression and distribution comparators on the gross deltas, and concentration passed. result.summary: The core accepted stack does NOT lose in chop: chop-bucket mean PnL is +$2,991 (positive) and Spearman(p_choppy, pnl) is +0.116 pooled and positive in all three windows -- the opposite sign of the FGRS sleeve (-0.324). The core enters in chop only 10% of the time because its entry gates already concentrate entries in trend regimes. Applying the regime_chop_state soft down-tilt to the whole core book would have cut core PnL by -$29,048 (~12%). Conclusion: chop-sensitivity is sleeve-specific, not portfolio-wide. A portfolio-level chop tilt must be scoped to the default-off sleeves with individually-negative Spearman(p_choppy, pnl), never the core stack, and validated on forward entry-regime-tagged rows -- not by re-slicing these frozen windows. Caveat: chop-bucket N is small (6 core trades); direction is robust across windows, magnitude is indicative.

experiments.interpretation: Every accepted default-off candidate-pool sleeve EXCEPT the core-flow-confirmed industry_stable_core_flow shares the FGRS chop-loss, confirming chop-sensitivity is a property of standalone candidate-pool sleeves, not the portfolio. Pooled Spearman(p_choppy,pnl): fiftytwo_week_high_proximity -0.298 (n=54), supplier_financing_debt_relief -0.232 (n=88), sbc_burden_improvement -0.227 (n=108), distribution_day_absorption_leadership -0.126 (n=113), turn_of_month_liquid_leadership -0.122 (n=73); near-zero/positive: narrow_range_compression_breakout -0.023 (n=44, only 2 chop trades), revision_surprise_low_extension +0.005 (0 chop trades), industry_stable_core_flow +0.054 (chop is its BEST bucket +$124/trade, matching the core stack +0.116 because the sleeve requires same-day core entry flow). Per-regime separation is the FGRS pattern: for chop-negative sleeves choppy_range is the ONLY losing bucket while risk_on_trend AND risk_off_stress stay strongly positive (sbc_burden: risk_on +$122/win65%, risk_off +$600/win90%, chop -$126/win22%). SCOPE decision for the sanctioned chop down-tilt: cover fiftytwo_week_high_proximity, supplier_financing_debt_relief, sbc_burden_improvement, turn_of_month_liquid_leadership (plus FGRS); distribution_day_absorption is borderline (negative Spearman but chop-bucket mean ~$0); EXCLUDE industry_stable_core_flow, narrow_range_compression (too few chop trades to size), revision_surprise (no chop trades), and the core stack. CAVEAT: observed_only -- the frozen-window counterfactual soft tilt CUTS PnL for every sleeve (-$148 to -$1,428) because these windows are net-positive, so the tilt cannot be proven by re-slicing; it needs forward entry-regime-tagged loss-making chop rows. Chop-bucket N per sleeve is small (2-23); Spearman uses continuous p_choppy over the full n=31-113 sample (robust statistic); magnitudes are indicative.
